response.justification: Despite a strong general software engineering background, the candidate lacks demonstrated C++ experience on Windows and has no visible exposure to capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains — both of which are mandatory for this role. Their recent work is centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-specific C++ development in financial systems.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across diverse technologies and platforms
Strong track record in open-source contributions and developer tooling
Proven ability to deliver complex systems with CI/CD and testing best practices
concerns: No demonstrable C++ experience on Windows platform as required
Absence of any capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain exposure
SQL experience listed but not tied to SQL Server or Oracle in financial contexts
